items.title: Charles Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997
items.q: That was with the Benny Goodman Trio, quartet, whatever, with Lionel Hampton

ctx.x: They seem to — I guess music has helped to lead the way in that respect. I remember recently when Jackie Robinson, they celebrated his 50th anniversary of breaking the color barrier in sports, but I think music preceded that.
Oh, yeah, definitely. That was with the Benny Goodman Trio, quartet, whatever, with Lionel Hampton, they kind of got over this — ‘39? And Billie Holiday with, which band did she play with?
